provenance: Exact JSON values transcribed from the two retained Chrome DevTools MCP evaluate_script responses in this profiling task; not a new measurement.
method: Bounded wrappers around WebGL2RenderingContext.drawElements and drawArrays appended performance.now() to window.__submit for each real draw submission. After the packet and liner settled open, two read-only evaluate_script calls returned performance.now(), window.__submit.length, and location.href. No input occurred between these probes.
scope: No additional intercepted draw submissions over this settled interval. This does not assert that every browser/GPU process was idle.
